title: Seven planes across Europe searched or diverted after ‘malicious hoax’ bomb threats
paragraphs: At least seven planes around Europe were searched or diverted after a series of bomb threats to passenger flights on Tuesday.
Two UK departures and a number of Ryanair flights were threatened in what the UK government called “malicious hoaxes”, after all planes landed safely and no explosives were found.
It was not clear if the incidents were linked, although authorities in Bulgaria and Italy said threats were made against two incoming Ryanair flights.
